Description: Partner profile type fell through as undefined unless present in metadata
Root Cause: Read pMeta['partnerType'] instead of prof.partnerType column
Remediation Applied: Updated resolvePartnerProfile to inspect first-class prof.partnerType before metadata

Description: RLS policy on company.partner_profiles blocked row access during staff creation
Root Cause: Query executed on raw database connection without withSecurityContext setting tenant_id
Remediation Applied: Wrapped profile resolution inside withSecurityContext and added operationalPartners lookup

Description: Walk-in encounter without doctorId auto-assigns first attending physician
Root Cause: Design choice to avoid unassigned triage patient stalling
Remediation Applied: Requires clinical triage nurse to confirm or reassign in queue console

Description: Activation link and granular permission endpoints contain synthetic mock fallbacks on 404
Root Cause: Legacy mock fixtures retained during Phase 6 API migration
Remediation Applied: Fails closed in production when strict mock flags disabled; recommended for cleanup before general release
